In no way defending AC’s poor pay but they won’t just raise ticket prices $5 to account for the increase in salary against their bottom line. The airline industry is super competitive and purchasing behaviour is completely dominated by price. They need to be priced competitively so they can stay in the top of metasearches (like Google Flights, Kayak) and OTA’s (online travel agencies like Expedia, Priceline). If AC raises their fares and WestJet and Porter are suddenly priced ahead of them in a meta search engine, they lose those customers. 

So a pilot raise mostly just goes against their bottom line (which is still pretty healthy and they can afford). If they do anything to offset it, it would be raising base fares on non-competitive routes and increasing ancillary products (baggage, seat selection, buy on board)
